# The history rewrite of 2026-10-18

Before this repo was first pushed, a machine's private tailnet hostname was
replaced with the placeholder `<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net` throughout its
history (`git filter-repo --replace-text`). It appeared only in Midnight
Playground's docs, from 2026-10-03 on, so that game's commits from then on,
and every merge after them, have new hashes. The engine's and Snowboarding's
commits, and Midnight Playground's older ones, are unchanged.

The docs in this repo were updated to cite the new hashes. Hashes elsewhere,
in the old `~/Software/midnight-playground` checkout, its GitHub repo
before it was rewritten the same way, or links to them, are the old ones.
The table below maps each old hash to the new one, in that order
(`grep <old hash> docs/history-rewrite.md`).
